description: This file contains the PHP class implementation for the Logout controller within the Opencart admin common namespace, responsible for handling the logout process in the admin interface.

classes.name: Logout
classes.description: The Logout class extends the base controller class and provides functionality to logout an admin user by clearing session data and redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Executes the logout process by calling the user logout method, unsetting session data related to user authentication, and redirecting to the login page.
